incentive_fee_mechanics.base_management_fee: 1.50% annual of average weekly gross assets excluding cash and cash equivalents, reduced by permanent waiver to 1.0% on all assets financed using leverage over 1.0x debt-to-equity. Payable quarterly in arrears. (Note 4. Related Party Transactions)
incentive_fee_mechanics.subordinated_income_incentive_fee_quote: 'The subordinated income incentive fee under the Advisory Agreement, which is calculated and payable quarterly in arrears, equals 17.5% of the Company's “pre-incentive fee net investment income” for the immediately preceding quarter and is subject to a hurdle rate, expressed as a rate of return on the value of the Company's net assets, equal to 1.75% per quarter, or an annualized hurdle rate of 7.0%. As a result, the Adviser will not earn this incentive fee for any quarter until the Company's pre-incentive fee net investment income for such quarter exceeds the hurdle rate of 1.75%. Once the Company's pre-incentive fee net investment income in any quarter exceeds the hurdle rate, the Adviser will be entitled to a “catch-up” fee equal to the amount of the pre-incentive fee net investment income in excess of the hurdle rate, until the Company's pre-incentive fee net investment income for such quarter equals 2.12%, or 8.48% annually, of net assets. Thereafter, the Adviser will be entitled to receive 17.5% of pre-incentive fee net investment income.'
incentive_fee_mechanics.capital_gains_incentive_fee: 20.0% of cumulative-from-inception realized capital gains net of realized losses and unrealized depreciation, less prior capital-gains incentive fees, determined annually. Accrued quarterly as if due. Cumulative net depreciation means none is currently payable.
incentive_fee_mechanics.does_pik_count_toward_pre_incentive_fee_: NOT DEFINED IN THIS FILING. Neither Note 2 nor Note 4 nor the MD&A defines 'pre-incentive fee net investment income' as including or excluding accrued-but-uncollected (PIK / OID) income; the 10-Q gives only the 17.5%/1.75% formula. However the fee is levied off net investment income, and GAAP NII as reported ON THIS FILING'S INCOME STATEMENT INCLUDES the three 'Paid-in-kind interest income' lines ($42mm in Q2'26, 14.5% of investment income) and accretion of discount. On that basis PIK is fee-bearing unless the Advisory Agreement (not filed as an exhibit to this 10-Q) carves it out. FLAGGED AS A COVERAGE GAP — resolve against the Advisory Agreement / most recent proxy.
incentive_fee_mechanics.fskr_merger_carve_out_quote: 'The Adviser has agreed to exclude from the calculation of the subordinated income incentive fee and the incentive fee on capital gains any changes to the fair value recorded for the assets and liabilities of FSKR resulting solely from the new cost basis of the acquired FSKR investments determined in accordance with Accounting Standards Codification Topic 805-50, Business Combinations—Related Issues as a result of the June 16, 2021 merger of FSKR.'
incentive_fee_mechanics.fee_waiver_quote: 'On June 29, 2026, the Adviser delivered to the Company a waiver letter, or the Waiver Letter, pursuant to which, beginning with the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2026 and continuing through and including the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2027, or the Waiver Period, the Adviser has agreed to waive 50% of the subordinated income incentive fee that the Adviser would otherwise be entitled to receive from the Company under the Advisory Agreement for each fiscal quarter during the Waiver Period. No portion of such waived subordinated income incentive fee will be subject to recoupment.'
incentive_fee_mechanics.extractor_observation: The waiver was signed June 29, 2026 — one day before quarter end and five weeks before the 10-Q. Without the $11mm waiver Q2 NII would be $111mm ($0.396/sh), BELOW the $0.42 distribution. The waiver is the sole reason 2026Q2 NII/share (0.43) covers the distribution (0.42).
incentive_fee_mechanics.source_note: Note 2. Significant Accounting Policies (fee accrual policy), Note 4. Related Party Transactions, and the Fees and Expenses table footnote (6) in Item 1A/Part II.

legacy_merger_and_jv_assets.fskr_merger: FSK is the surviving entity of mergers with Corporate Capital Trust, Inc. (CCT) and FS KKR Capital Corp. II (FSKR, merged June 16, 2021). Merger accounting re-based GAAP cost: aggregate TAX cost of investments is $13,371 vs GAAP amortized cost of $12,605 at 6/30/26 (a $766mm gap), and tax-basis net unrealized depreciation is $(1,953) vs GAAP $(1,187). Note 6: 'The aggregate net unrealized appreciation (depreciation) on investments on a tax basis excludes net unrealized appreciation (depreciation) from merger accounting...'. Interpretation: the GAAP mark understates cumulative economic loss versus original cash cost by roughly $766mm because merger accounting reset the basis downward.
legacy_merger_and_jv_assets.asset_based_finance: $1,626mm cost / $1,436mm fair value = 88.3% of cost, 12.6% of the portfolio at 6/30/26 (vs $1,831 / $1,694 = 92.5% and 13.0% at 12/31/25). ABF holdings are largely equity/structured-mezzanine interests in SPVs and aggregators (e.g. 'Roemanu LLC, ABF Equity', 'Global Jet Capital LLC, Preferred Stock', 'KKR Altitude II Offshore Aggregator LP, Partnership Interest', '801 5th Ave, Seattle, Structured Mezzanine', 'Prime ST LLC, Structured Mezzanine'), i.e. Level 3 non-traded positions with no par to mark against. Three of the seven new non-accruals this quarter are ABF structured-mezzanine positions.

Giving effect to the transaction, COPJV had total capital commitments of $2,975, $2,450 of which was from the Company and the remaining $525 of which was from SCRS. As of June 30, 2026, the Company and SCRS have funded $2,520.0 to COPJV, of which $2,016.0 was from the Company.'

WHETHER PIK COUNTS TOWARD PRE-INCENTIVE-FEE NII IS NOT STATED. The 10-Q gives the 17.5% / 1.75% quarterly hurdle / 2.12% catch-up formula but never defines 'pre-incentive fee net investment income' with respect to accrued non-cash income. The Advisory Agreement is not an exhibit to this 10-Q. GAAP NII on the face of the income statement does include PIK, so PIK is fee-bearing on that reading, but this is inference, not filed text.

NO QUARTERLY (three-month) PIK PERCENTAGE IS FILED. The 13.5% / 14.4% cash-vs-PIK split in Note 5 footnote (1) is six-month only. The 14.5% (Q2'26) and 13.3% (Q2'25) quarterly percentages are extractor-computed from the income statement.

PIK COMPONENT LINES DO NOT FOOT TO THE XBRL TOTAL. The three Q2'25 'Paid-in-kind interest income' lines sum to 53 while the XBRL-tagged total implies 52; six-month 2025 components sum to 115 vs the cash-flow statement's 116. Rounding at $1mm granularity, but the 13.3% Q2'25 PIK share could be 13.1%.

NO PIK-BY-ISSUER CONCENTRATION TABLE. The affiliate-transaction rollforward tables do give per-company PIK income for AFFILIATED issuers only; there is no equivalent for non-controlled/unaffiliated issuers, so PIK concentration across the whole portfolio cannot be measured from this filing.

INVESTMENT RATING TABLE IS FAIR VALUE ONLY — no amortized-cost or issuer-count breakdown per rating bucket, and no rating disclosed at the individual position level, so rating migration cannot be tied to specific names.

SOI 'par' IS NULL FOR EQUITY-ONLY ISSUERS. For issuers held solely through equity, preferred, partnership or ABF-equity interests (COPJV, athenahealth Inc, JW Aluminum Co, Roemanu LLC, Global Jet Capital LLC, KKR Altitude II Offshore Aggregator LP) the SOI reports share/unit counts rather than a Principal Amount, so fv_pct_of_par is null. fv_pct_of_cost is provided instead for those names.

TOP-20 ISSUER AGGREGATION IS EXTRACTOR LOGIC, NOT A FILED TABLE. The 10-Q publishes no top-holdings list. Names were normalized by stripping security descriptors ('Common Stock', 'Preferred Stock', 'ABF Equity', 'Structured Mezzanine', etc.) to roll tranches up to the issuer. Verbatim per-instrument names are preserved in each entry's instruments_as_filed array. Two issuers changed legal name between periods ('Amerivet Partners Management Inc' -> 'AVE Holdings I Corp (fka Amerivet Partners Management Inc)') and were not auto-linked.

NO FETCH OR PARSE FAILURES. The filing was fetched DIRECT from SEC (full Chrome fingerprint, no proxy). All 616 June-2026 SOI line items parsed; the only 6 rows the parser skipped are the SOI's own 'Unfunded Loan/Debt/Asset Based Finance Commitments' contra lines and 'Net ...' subtotal lines, which are handled explicitly. Both cost and fair value tie to the filed totals within $0.5mm (0.004%).
